Scope: Local background resource snapshots; workloads and supported devices differ. Not a startup-latency or animation-speed benchmark. Known disk roots include caches and existing shared components; not a clean-install disk delta.
RAM: Private working set is private physical RAM. Summed total working sets may double-count shared pages. Private commit is a separate virtual-memory metric.
CPU: CPU-time counter deltas divided by Stopwatch wall time and 16 logical processors; 100% is the entire machine. Kernel-driver allocations and work outside attributed processes are not included.
Disk: MiB = 1048576 bytes. Known logical file sizes; allocation values are FileStandardInfo.AllocationSize where available. NTFS metadata, hard-link deduplication and generic Windows Installer/driver-store caches are not fully accounted for. Razer ProgramData enumeration had one access error, so its footprint is a lower bound.
